basics.name: Abdul Sami
basics.label: AI Engineer — Computer Vision, Generative Models, Edge Deployment
basics.summary: AI Engineer at DeltaX, building perception systems for autonomous driving and in-cabin monitoring, and a researcher in diffusion-based generative modelling. Experienced across the full path from training in PyTorch to quantized models running in real time on embedded automotive hardware, with four peer-reviewed publications in generative image synthesis.

work.name: DeltaX
work.summary: Computer vision for autonomous driving and in-cabin monitoring, from model training through to embedded deployment.
highlights: Engineering end-to-end computer vision pipelines and post-processing logic for in-cabin monitoring systems (ICMS) in next-generation vehicles.
Building driver and occupant monitoring features: seatbelt compliance, distraction detection (gaze away, phone use, hands off wheel), and occupant classification.
Converting models for embedded deployment with INT8 / FP16 post-training quantization and custom calibration for real-time, low-power inference.
Compiling and benchmarking models along the PyTorch to ONNX to TI TIDL path for TDA4VM and AM6xA-class SoCs.

work.name: System Software Lab, Soongsil University
highlights: Conducting advanced research in machine learning and generative modeling, with a focus on diffusion models for image generation and font synthesis.
Developed a novel few-shot conditional diffusion pipeline for structurally accurate multilingual font generation across Korean, Chinese, and English scripts..
Trained and evaluated YOLOv8 models for object detection; supported experiments in image segmentation and classification tasks.
Contributed to multiple publications: one accepted at an international conference (ICOIN 2025), one journal paper under final review, and another in preparation.
Built and fine-tuned models using PyTorch, incorporating VGG-based feature extraction, CLIP embeddings, OpenCV processing, and reference-style input conditioning.
Led dataset preparation, model training, and metric-driven evaluation (SSIM, LPIPS, FID) for font generation and vision-related projects.
Actively collaborated in a fast-paced research environment exploring LLM integration and multimodal generative AI systems.

work.name: Soongsil University
work.position: Teaching Assistant - Artificial Intelligence & Deep Learning
highlights: Supporting graduate-level courses in Artificial Intelligence and Deep Learning for Master’s students.
Conducting hands-on coding tutorials and lab sessions focused on neural networks, CNNs, and modern deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch).
Delivering occasional lectures and assisting with conceptual understanding of key topics in generative models and  applied AI.
Designing mid-term and final exams, grading assignments, and providing one-on-one academic guidance to students

projects.name: DK-Font: Diffusion-Based Multilingual Font Generation
projects.description: Novel diffusion model with phonetic-aware encoding, multi-reference style learning and iterative correction for high-fidelity font sets.

projects.name: Hangul Classifier
projects.description: Deep-CNN classifier (AlexNet) achieving 95 %+ accuracy across diverse Korean font styles.

projects.name: Real-Time Face-Recognition Attendance System
projects.description: Desktop application that detects faces in live video and auto-records attendance.

publications.name: Sami-Font: Structure and Style-Aware Multi-Scale Infusion for One-Shot Multilingual Typeface Generation
publications.summary: One-shot typeface generation that infuses style at multiple scales of the denoising network while structure-aware losses preserve stroke topology across Korean, Chinese, and Latin scripts.

publications.name: DML-Font: Multilingual Font Generation based on Diffusion Model
publications.publisher: KSII Transactions on Internet and Information Systems, 20(5), 2525-2552
publications.summary: A diffusion-based framework for multilingual font generation with fine-grained style control and stroke-level structural consistency.

publications.name: Positional Component-Guided Hangul Font Image Generation via Deep Semantic Segmentation and Adversarial Style Transfer
publications.summary: YOLOv8-driven positional decomposition of Hangul into initial, medial, and final components, recombined by a GAN for improved structure and style preservation.

publications.name: Text-Conditioned Diffusion Model for High-Fidelity Korean Font Generation
publications.publisher: IEEE International Conference on Information Networking (ICOIN) 2025
publications.summary: A one-shot, text-conditioned diffusion model that synthesizes a full Korean typeface from a single reference glyph.

publications.name: Disentangled Diffusion for Multilingual Character Generation
publications.summary: Image generation of multilingual characters with diffusion models, disentangling content and style to produce visually consistent and structurally accurate glyphs across writing systems.
